source: polyDB (https://polydb.org), collection Polytopes.Lattice.SmoothReflexive, REST API https://polydb.org/rest/current/find/Polytopes.Lattice.SmoothReflexive?query={"DIM":d}; data by Andreas Paffenholz (http://polymake.org/polytopes/paffenholz/www/fano.html), computed with Mikkel Obro's classification algorithm (arXiv:0704.0049). Retrieved 2026-07-10.
convention: vertices are primitive ray generators of the fan in N; polytope is the convex hull (smooth Fano polytope: reflexive, every facet a unimodular simplex). NOTE: polyDB stores the DUAL convention (the smooth reflexive moment polytope P in M, polymake VERTICES/FACETS); the fan polytope Q given here was obtained exactly as Q = conv of the primitive integer facet normals of P (each polyDB FACETS row [a0,a1..an], rescaled to primitive integers, has a0 = 1, and (a1..an) is a vertex of Q). Verified per polytope: all vertices primitive; for every vertex w of P the set {v in Q : <v,w> = -1} is a facet of Q that is a unimodular simplex (|det| = 1), all Q-vertices satisfy <v,w> >= -1, every Q-vertex lies on a facet, and the facet count of Q equals the vertex count of P. Origin is strictly interior (all facets at lattice distance 1). The id is the polyDB _id; extra.dual_polydb holds combinatorial data of the stored dual P (not of Q).
